mapper.insert: INSERT INTO play_history (user_id, song_id, played_at, source, duration_seconds) VALUES (#{userId}, #{songId}, #{playedAt}, #{source}, #{durationSeconds})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, song_id AS songId, played_at AS playedAt, source, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds FROM play_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND song_id = #{songId} ORDER BY played_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
